fieldNotes.truckGate: Compound fully enclosed by chain-link fence; single access road off Rockdale Industrial Blvd terminates in a chain-link gate across the truck lane (2026-02 Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the fence gate or building front in any Street View heading (2026-02 imagery). Gate is chain-link only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard booth -> kiosk / call-box / app check-in implied.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Gravel area outside the fence along the access road holds parked/overflow trailers - functions as pre-gate staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock face along the south leg of the L-shaped building; ~10-12 trailers backed in plus visible dock rhythm -> estimated ~18 doors, 10-25 band. Count is approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large fanned-out trailer drop yard on the south/southwest apron; ~30-40 trailers visible parked without tractors -> 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage area on the south apron plus overflow trailers on gravel outside the fence -> true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Conyers GA - Rockdale Industrial Blvd is a small-town industrial park on the outer edge of metro Atlanta, bordered by woods and grading land. Per rubric, small-town industrial -> Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; building is a thermoforming/foodservice converting plant with resin silos, truck-served only.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the gate to the south dock apron easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
